name: Honcho
summary: Honcho, from Plastic Labs, is open-source memory infrastructure that stores messages between peers (users or agents) and reasons over them in the background to build a representation of each peer. Apps query it for context or ask it questions about a user in natural language.
goodFor: Modeling users and their preferences over time
Multi-agent setups where peers observe each other
Plugging memory into Hermes, OpenClaw, Claude Code
watchOut: Background reasoning adds latency before insights appear
